17	Below `md:` (768px) every table collapses to a vertical card list. Linear's issue list is the gold standard: **title (16/600) on line 1, status dot + assignee avatar + due chip on line 2, priority + project on line 3**. Stripe payments on mobile-web stacks amount + status on line 1, customer + date on line 2, chevron right. Fresha's client list: avatar · name+phone · last visit date.
18	
19	**Card anatomy for InkOS (375×~88px tap row):**
20	- Line 1: primary (client name / booking title) — 16px/600, truncate
21	- Line 2: 2–3 chips (status · artist · time) — 12px/500
22	- Line 3: metadata (service · price) — 12px/400 muted
23	- Whole card tappable, `min-h-[64px]`, `active:bg-muted`, chevron optional
24	
25	Never horizontal-scroll a desktop table on mobile. Reports page = tabs → cards, not scroll.
26	
27	## 3. Bottom sheets replace dialogs
28	
29	**Rule:** on `<md`, every `<Dialog>` becomes a bottom sheet. Native research shows bottom sheets get 25–30% higher engagement than centered modals because they match thumb position and dismiss with a natural swipe-down.
30	
31	Use Vaul (React drawer) with:
32	- **Snap points:** `[0.4, 0.9]` — peek for filters/pickers, full for forms
33	- **Drag handle:** 36×4px pill, 8px top, `bg-muted`
34	- **Drag-to-dismiss:** velocity ≥ 0.4 or drag > 40% of height
35	- **Backdrop:** `bg-black/40` + `backdrop-blur-sm`
36	- **Height cap:** `max-h-[90dvh]` (dynamic viewport unit = keyboard-safe per iOS 15.4+)
37	- **Rounded top:** `rounded-t-2xl`
38	- **Critical destructive confirms** stay as centered AlertDialog (prevents accidental swipe-dismiss)
39	
40	Applies to: filter panels, new-booking quick-add, client-quick-view, consent form signing prompt, payment-method picker.
41	
42	## 4. FAB placement + safe-area insets
43	
44	Fresha's artist day view has a **bottom-right FAB** (`+`, 56×56) for "new appointment" — the single most-used action. Linear Mobile promoted the "Create Issue" button to a persistent top-of-screen slot in the 2025 redesign (evidence that FAB-only-for-primary is the rule).
45	
46	**InkOS FAB rules:**
47	- One FAB per screen, never two
48	- Primary screens only: Calendar (new booking), Clients (new client), Inventory (new item)
49	- Position: `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 72px)` (clears bottom nav + 16px), `right: 16px`
50	- Size: 56×56, `rounded-full`, electric-purple bg, `shadow-card` elevated
51	- Tap target stays 56 even if icon is 24
52	- Hides on scroll-down, returns on scroll-up (Fresha pattern)
53	- Respects `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]` on iOS notch devices
54	
55	## 5. Pull-to-refresh
56	
57	**Split call.** iOS Safari standalone PWAs explicitly disable native pull-to-refresh, so we must implement or skip. Linear Mobile (native) has it. Fresha native has it. Cron mobile-web does NOT. Notion mobile-web does NOT. Stripe Dashboard native YES, web NO.
58	
59	**InkOS verdict:** Implement custom PTR only on 3 list screens (Bookings, Clients, Inventory) using `touchstart/touchmove` with `transform: translateY` + a spinner at 60px pull threshold. Use `overscroll-behavior: contain` to prevent double-bounce. Everywhere else, rely on router revalidation. Don't over-ship — PTR on a form or calendar is an antipattern.
60	
61	## 6. Mobile typography scaling
62	
63	Competitor ratios (body text desktop → mobile):
64	- Linear: 14 → 14 (no change, relies on line-height)
65	- Stripe: 14 → 14 (same)
66	- Fresha: 15 → 14
67	- Notion: 16 → 15
68	- Height: 13 → 13 (tight)
69	
70	**InkOS scale:**
71	- h1: 30 → **24** (−20%)
72	- h2: 24 → **20**
73	- h3: 20 → **18**
74	- body: 14 → **14** (unchanged, hold line-height 1.5)
75	- caption: 12 → **12**
76	- Inputs: 16 on mobile (sub-16 triggers iOS auto-zoom — always use 16+)
77	
78	## 7. Touch targets — 44×44 minimum
79	
80	Apple HIG: 44×44pt. Material: 48×48dp. WCAG 2.5.5 AAA: 44×44 CSS px. Common violations audited across the six:
81	- Table row action icons at 24×24 (Notion, Stripe mobile-web — rage-tap territory)
82	- Close "×" buttons at 32×32 (Height, early Linear)
83	- Overflow "⋯" menus shrinking to 28×28 (Cron mobile-web)
84	
85	**InkOS hard gate:** audit every `<button>`, `<a>`, `[role=button]`, form control. Minimum `min-h-11 min-w-11` (44px). Icon-only buttons: `h-11 w-11` with a 20–24px icon centered. Spacing between adjacent targets: 8px min. Sage blocks merge if violated.
86	
87	## 8. Mobile calendar
88	
89	Fresha on 375px defaults to **Day view with agenda list** (not grid) — most practical for artists who only care about "what's next." Swipe horizontal = next/previous day (left=forward, right=back, matches iOS Calendar). Time slots: 30-min rows, current time red line, tap empty slot → bottom sheet "new appointment."
90	
91	Cron mobile keeps time-grid day view (engineer audience). Linear/Stripe/Notion/Height have no calendar.
92	
93	**InkOS calendar:**
94	- `<md` default: Day agenda view. No week-grid ever — unreadable at 375px
95	- Header: `← [Mon Apr 17] →` with current day. Tap date = mini-month picker bottom sheet
96	- Swipe left/right on body = change day (use Framer Motion `dragConstraints`, threshold 80px or velocity 0.3)
97	- Time grid: 60px per 30-min row, current time red 2px line
98	- Tap empty slot → bottom sheet with prefilled time
99	- Tap booking → bottom sheet detail peek (40% snap)
100	- Pinch-zoom deferred to v2
101	
102	## 9. Keyboard avoidance
103	
104	The 2025 winning pattern is **dynamic viewport units + `interactiveWidget: 'resizes-content'`** — no JS observer needed. iOS 15.4+ and all Android Chrome support this.
105	
106	**InkOS form rules:**
107	- Root containers use `min-h-[100dvh]`, never `100vh` (vh doesn't account for keyboard)
108	- Sticky bottom CTA: `bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, position `sticky`, parent has `dvh`
109	- Set `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, interactive-widget=resizes-content">`
110	- On focus, scroll target into view: `input.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' })` with 120ms delay (iOS keyboard open time)
111	- Bottom sheets with forms: `max-h-[85dvh]` so keyboard doesn't crop submit button
112	- Known iOS 26 Safari bug: `visualViewport.offsetTop` drifts 0→24px after dismiss — add a 300ms post-blur window scroll-to-top as workaround
113	
114	## 10. Mobile empty states
115	
116	Desktop empty states lecture. Mobile empty states must be scannable in one thumb-glance.
117	
118	**Ratio:** desktop icon 48px → mobile **64px**. Copy desktop 2 sentences → mobile **1 sentence + 1 CTA**. Linear: "No issues. Create your first →". Height: "Nothing here yet" + big `+`. Fresha: illustration + single button.
119	
120	**InkOS pattern per list:**
121	- 64×64 illustration or glyph
122	- One-line headline 16/600
123	- Optional 14/400 subline (max 40 chars)
124	- One primary button, full-width minus 32px margin, `h-12`
125	- Example: "No bookings today" / "Tap + to create one"
126	
127	## 11. Mobile tabs
128	
129	Scrollable + fade-edge is the consensus. Underline > pill for B2B (Linear, Stripe, Notion all underline). Pill fits consumer/ios-native vibe (Fresha customer app).
130	
131	**InkOS:**
132	- Use underline tabs on all report pages and settings sections
133	- Container: `overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide`, `snap-x snap-mandatory`
134	- Fade edge: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 16px, black calc(100% - 16px), transparent)`
135	- Active tab: 2px bottom border electric-purple, 14/500 text; inactive: 14/400 muted
136	- Min padding per tab: 16px horizontal, 12px vertical (hit-target 44)
137	- Auto-scroll active tab to center on mount
138	
139	Pills reserved for segmented controls (e.g., "Day / Week / Month" toggle) — 2–3 options max.
140	
141	## 12. Mobile search
142	
143	Two patterns:
144	- **Inline:** persistent bar at top — for search-primary screens (Clients, Inventory)
145	- **Icon → full-screen overlay:** for secondary search (Bookings, Reports)
146	
147	Linear uses the icon→overlay pattern. Stripe mobile-web: inline sticky. Fresha clients: inline sticky at top of list. Notion: icon in header → full-screen.
148	
149	**InkOS rule:** Clients and Inventory pages ship inline sticky search (`top-14`, below header, `bg-background/80 backdrop-blur`). Bookings, reports, global nav: icon button → full-screen overlay with recent searches, auto-focus input, Esc/swipe-down to close. Search input always 16px text (no iOS zoom).
